# Marketing & Sales Software

> Independent, hands-researched reviews of marketing, sales, e-commerce and growth software. 86 full reviews live here as the canonical version; prices are read on the vendor's page and dated. Last updated 2026-09-22.

AIBuilder Marketplace and its sister sites are run by Daniel Haket, a former banker. Every price is read on the vendor's own page and dated; every review says who should skip the tool. Affiliate links never change a verdict. Six sites, one owner.

## Start here
- [Cost-trap atlas](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/atlas.html): every tool in this niche with its documented pricing traps
- [Price Watch](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/price-watch.html): dated price changes, free-tier cuts and renewal jumps
- [Straight answers](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/answers.html): is it worth it, what does it really cost, what is the catch — per tool
- [Tool finder](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/finder.html): pick a tool in under a minute
- [Deals](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/deals.html): current deals and free trials
